```{r setup}
rm(list=ls())


# project folder = parent of the analysis folder that contains this file
input <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
analysis_dir <- if (is.null(input)) getwd() else dirname(input)
projectDir <- dirname(normalizePath(analysis_dir))

## Install packages if needed
packages <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr", "plyr", "cowplot", "rmarkdown", 'ggpubr', 'Rmisc',
              "readr", 'tidyverse' ,'reshape2', 'effectsize', 'rstatix', 'afex')

if (length(setdiff(packages, rownames(installed.packages()))) > 0) {
  install.packages(setdiff(packages, rownames(installed.packages())))  
}

# call packages
lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)

# modeling type
mod_type <- 'fmin'
# mod_type <- 'vba'  # for the exploratory VBA models

## Directories
code_dir <- file.path(projectDir, 'analysis')
results_dir <- file.path(projectDir, 'derivatives')
exp1 <- file.path(results_dir, 'Experiment1')
exp2 <- file.path(results_dir, 'Experiment2')
pool_dir <- file.path(results_dir,'Pooled')

if (mod_type == 'fmin'){
  sim_dir <- file.path(pool_dir,'simulations') 
}else{
sim_dir <- file.path(pool_dir,'simulations_vba')}

source(file.path(code_dir,'corPlot.R'))
source(file.path(code_dir,'confMatrix.R'))

```
performance:deviance
```{r deviance plots}
devdir1 <- read.csv(file = file.path(exp1, 'Colorwheel', 'MedianAccOut.csv'))
devdir1$experiment <- 1
devdir1$subNo <- devdir1$subNo + 100
devdir2 <- read.csv(file = file.path(exp2, 'Colorwheel', 'MedianAccOut.csv'))
devdir2$experiment <- 2

devdir <- rbind(devdir1,devdir2)

#long format
dev_long <- devdir %>% pivot_longer(cols = matches("^[IU][1-4]$"), 
    names_to = c("condition", "setSize"), names_pattern = "^(I|U)([1-4])$", values_to = "deviance")

##make summary statistics
AccS=Rmisc::summarySEwithin(dev_long, measurevar="deviance", withinvars=c("setSize","condition"), betweenvars = 'experiment', idvar="subNo")

# repeated measures ANOVA
 dev_1 <- dev_long %>% filter(experiment ==1)

# repeated-measures ANOVA experiment 1
aov_model_1 <- aov_car(deviance ~ setSize * condition + Error(subNo/(setSize * condition)), 
                     data = dev_1, type = 3)

# Get the ANOVA table
print(aov_model_1)

# Get effect sizes
effect_sizes_1 <- effectsize::eta_squared(aov_model_1, partial = TRUE)
print(effect_sizes_1)

# repeated-measures ANOVA experiment 2
dev_2 <- dev_long %>% filter(experiment == 2)

aov_model_2 <- aov_car(deviance ~ setSize * condition + Error(subNo/(setSize * condition)), 
                     data = dev_2, type = 3)

# Get the ANOVA table
print(aov_model_2)

# Get effect sizes
effect_sizes_2 <- effectsize::eta_squared(aov_model_2, partial = TRUE)
print(effect_sizes_2)

## deviance linegraph + data points
graph1=ggplot(AccS, aes(x = as.numeric(setSize), y = deviance, color= condition,shape=condition)) + 
    geom_point(aes(shape=condition),position = position_dodge( w =0.15),size=3,alpha=0.7)+geom_line(aes(group = condition),position = position_dodge( w =0.15),size=1.5) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(15,16),name="Condition",labels=c("Ignore", "Update"))+ 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=deviance-se, ymax=deviance+se), width = 0.12,position = position_dodge( w =0.15),size=0.95)+
    scale_color_manual(labels=c("Ignore", "Update"),name="Condition",values = c('#004CBF',"#E90066" ))

graph1+ theme_classic2()+ theme(legend.position = "none") +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'dark grey', size = 1),
          text = element_text(size=15),axis.text =element_text(colour='#4D4E4F',size=20,face='bold'))+
    labs(x = "Set size", y = "Reaction time (seconds)")+ coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0, 30)) + theme(axis.title=element_blank())+
    theme(axis.line=element_blank(),text = element_text(size=15))+ 
    theme(axis.ticks.length = unit(.3, "cm"))+theme(aspect.ratio=0.9)+
    geom_point(data=dev_long,aes(x= as.numeric(setSize), y = deviance, color = condition),position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.4, jitter.height=0.01, dodge.width=0.3),size=3.5,shape=1,alpha=0.3)+facet_wrap(~experiment)


```
performance:reaction times
```{r Performance: RTs}

rtdir1 <- read.csv(file = file.path(exp1, 'Colorwheel', 'MedianRTOut.csv'))
rtdir1$experiment <- 1
rtdir1$subNo <- rtdir1$subNo + 100
rtdir2 <- read.csv(file = file.path(exp2, 'Colorwheel', 'MedianRTOut.csv'))
rtdir2$experiment <- 2

rtdir <- rbind(rtdir1,rtdir2)

#long format
rt_long <- rtdir %>% pivot_longer(cols = matches("^[IU][1-4]$"), 
    names_to = c("condition", "setSize"), names_pattern = "^(I|U)([1-4])$", values_to = "rt")

##make summary statistics
RTS=Rmisc::summarySEwithin(rt_long, measurevar="rt", withinvars=c("setSize","condition"), betweenvars = 'experiment', idvar="subNo")

# repeated measures ANOVA
 rt_1 <- rt_long %>% filter(experiment ==1)

# repeated-measures ANOVA experiment 1
aov_model_1 <- aov_car(rt ~ setSize * condition + Error(subNo/(setSize * condition)), 
                     data = rt_1, type = 3)

# Get the ANOVA table
print(aov_model_1)

# Get effect sizes
effect_sizes_1 <- effectsize::eta_squared(aov_model_1, partial = TRUE)
print(effect_sizes_1)

# repeated-measures ANOVA experiment 2
rt_2 <- rt_long %>% filter(experiment == 2)

aov_model_2 <- aov_car(rt ~ setSize * condition + Error(subNo/(setSize * condition)), 
                     data = rt_2, type = 3)

# Get the ANOVA table
print(aov_model_2)

# Get effect sizes
effect_sizes_2 <- effectsize::eta_squared(aov_model_2, partial = TRUE)
print(effect_sizes_2)
## rt plot

## rt linegraph + data points
graph1=ggplot(RTS, aes(x = as.numeric(setSize), y = rt, color= condition,shape=condition)) + 
    geom_point(aes(shape=condition),position=position_dodge(w=0.15),size=3,alpha=0.7)+geom_line(aes(group = condition),position=position_dodge(w=0.15),size=1.5) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(15,16),name="Condition",labels=c("Ignore", "Update"))+ 
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=rt-se, ymax=rt+se), width = 0.12,position=position_dodge(w=0.15),size=0.95)+
    scale_color_manual(labels=c("Ignore", "Update"),name="Condition",values = c('#004CBF',"#E90066" ))

graph1+ theme_classic2()+ theme(legend.position = "none") +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'dark grey', size = 1),
          text = element_text(size=15),axis.text =element_text(colour='#4D4E4F',size=20,face='bold'))+
    labs(x = "Set size", y = "Reaction time (seconds)")+ coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,3)) + theme(axis.title=element_blank())+
    theme(axis.line=element_blank(),text = element_text(size=15))+ 
    theme(axis.ticks.length = unit(.3, "cm"))+theme(aspect.ratio=0.9)+
    geom_point(data=rt_long,aes(x= as.numeric(setSize), y = rt, color = condition),position=position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.4, jitter.height=0.01, dodge.width=0.3),size=3.5,shape=1,alpha=0.3)+facet_wrap(~experiment)
```

motivation: ignore vs update
```{r direct comparison}
ipdir1 <- read.csv(file = file.path(exp1, 'COGED', 'IPDirectOut.csv'))
ipdir1$subNo <- ipdir1$subNo + 100

dataLong <- reshape(ipdir1,varying =c( "IP1","IP2","IP3","IP4"),direction = "long",idvar = "subNo",timevar="setSize",sep="")
dir_long_1 <- reshape2:::melt.data.frame(dataLong,id.vars=c('subNo','setSize'),value.name="ip")
dirS1 <- summarySEwithin(dir_long_1, measurevar="ip", withinvars=c("setSize"),idvar="subNo")

ipdir2 <- read.csv(file = file.path(exp2, 'COGED', 'IPDirectOut.csv'))

dataLong <- reshape(ipdir2,varying =c( "IP1","IP2","IP3","IP4"),direction = "long",idvar = "subNo",timevar="setSize",sep="")
dir_long_2 <- reshape2:::melt.data.frame(dataLong,id.vars=c('subNo','setSize'),value.name="ip")

# exclude participant 30 of experiment 2, who responded randomly in the ignore vs update choices
dir_long_2_ex <- dir_long_2 %>% dplyr::filter(subNo != 30)

dirS2 <- summarySEwithin(dir_long_2_ex, measurevar="ip", withinvars=c("setSize"),idvar="subNo")


#line plot  with raw data
pd=position_dodge(w=0.14)
pj=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.01)
graph3=ggplot(dirS1, aes(x = as.factor(setSize), y = ip, group=1)) + 
  geom_line(size=1, colour='darkgreen')+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=ip-se, ymax=ip+se), width = 0.06,size=0.95,colour='black')+#geom_point(size=2,colour='black',fill='white',shape=21,stroke=1.5)+
theme_classic() +
  geom_point(data=dir_long_1,aes(setSize,ip),position=pj,size=2.5,shape=1,alpha=0.3,colour='black')+   
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 2),linetype='dashed',color='grey')+
  geom_segment(x=1,xend=4.01,y=-0.2,yend=-0.2,color='black',size=0.73)+geom_segment(x=0.402,xend=0.402,y=0,yend=4,color='black',size=0.65)+
      theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'dark grey', size = 1), axis.title = element_text(size = 23, face = "bold",colour='#4D4E4F'),
          text = element_text(size=15),axis.text =element_text(colour='#4D4E4F',size=20,face='bold'))+
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,4)) +
    theme(axis.line=element_blank(),text = element_text(size=15))+ 
    theme(axis.ticks.length = unit(.3, "cm"))+theme(aspect.ratio=0.9)+  labs(x = "Set size", y = "Ignore vs Update \n Indifference point")+theme(aspect.ratio=0.8)
print(graph3)
ggsave(file.path(exp1, 'COGED', "oriDir.pdf"), height=7.5,width=7.5)
dev.off()


graph6=ggplot(dirS2, aes(x = as.factor(setSize), y = ip, group=1)) + 
  geom_line(size=1, colour='darkgreen')+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=ip-se, ymax=ip+se), width = 0.06,size=0.95,colour='black')+#geom_point(size=2,colour='black',fill='white',shape=21,stroke=1.5)+
theme_classic() +
  geom_point(data=dir_long_2,aes(setSize,ip),position=pj,size=2.5,shape=1,alpha=0.3,colour='black')+   
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 2),linetype='dashed',color='grey')+
  geom_segment(x=1,xend=4.01,y=-0.2,yend=-0.2,color='black',size=0.73)+geom_segment(x=0.402,xend=0.402,y=0,yend=4,color='black',size=0.65)+
      theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'dark grey', size = 1), axis.title = element_text(size = 23, face = "bold",colour='#4D4E4F'),
          text = element_text(size=15),axis.text =element_text(colour='#4D4E4F',size=20,face='bold'))+
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,4)) +
    theme(axis.line=element_blank(),text = element_text(size=15))+ 
    theme(axis.ticks.length = unit(.3, "cm"))+theme(aspect.ratio=0.9)+  labs(x = "Set size", y = "Ignore vs Update \n Indifference point")+theme(aspect.ratio=0.8)
print(graph6)
ggsave(file.path(exp2, 'COGED', "repDir_no30.pdf"), height=7.5,width=7.5)
```

```{r split direct in two groups, echo=FALSE}

ipdir1$experiment <- 1
ipdir2$experiment <- 2

ipdir <- rbind(ipdir1,ipdir2 %>% dplyr::filter(subNo != 30)) #combine two experiments
write.csv(ipdir,file.path(pool_dir, 'direct_pooled_r.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

ipdir$IPz <- scale(ipdir$IP, scale = T)
ipdir <- ipdir %>% dplyr::mutate(outlier = case_when(IPz >= 2.9 | IPz <= -2.9 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0))

dir_long_1$experiment <- 1
dir_long_2_ex$experiment <- 2

dir_long <- rbind(dir_long_1,dir_long_2_ex) #combine two experiments long format of data

pref_I <- ipdir %>% dplyr::filter(IP > 2) # & outlier == 0) #%>% dplyr::select(subNo) # subjects that prefer Ignore
write.csv(pref_I,file.path(pool_dir, 'direct_prefer_ignore.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

pref_U <- ipdir %>% dplyr::filter(IP < 2 )# & outlier == 0) #%>% dplyr::select(subNo) # subjects that prefer Update

# summarize
IPI <- summarySEwithin(dir_long %>% dplyr::filter(subNo %in% pref_I$subNo), measurevar="ip", withinvars=c("setSize"),idvar= c("subNo", 'experiment'))
IPU <- summarySEwithin(dir_long %>% dplyr::filter(subNo %in% pref_U$subNo), measurevar="ip", withinvars=c("setSize"),idvar= c("subNo", 'experiment'))

label_I <- sprintf("Prefer ignore (N = %d)",length(pref_I$subNo) )
label_U <- sprintf("Prefer update (N = %d)",length(pref_U$subNo) )

#two groups
graph3=ggplot(data=IPI, aes(x = as.factor(setSize), y = ip, group=1,lty= label_I))  +
    geom_errorbar(data=IPI,aes(ymin=ip-se, ymax=ip+se), width = 0.08,size=1.3)+geom_line(size=1.45)+geom_point(size=2, shape=21,stroke=1.2,color="black",fill='black')+ coord_cartesian(ylim=c(1, 3)) +
    theme(axis.line.x = element_line(colour = 'black', size=0.5, linetype='solid'), axis.line.y = element_line(colour = 'black', size=0.5, linetype='solid'))+
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 2),linetype='dashed',colour='grey')+
    geom_segment(x=1,xend=4.01,y=0.9,yend=0.9,color='black',size=0.75)+geom_segment(x=0.402,xend=0.402,y=0.9999,yend=3,color='black',size=0.65)+ scale_linetype('Preference')+
    geom_errorbar(data=IPU,aes(ymin=ip-se, ymax=ip+se), width = 0.08,size=1.3)+ geom_line(data=IPU, size=1.45,aes(lty=label_U))+
    geom_point(data=IPU, size=1,stroke=1.5,shape=23,fill='white')+
    theme(legend.text=element_text(size=20), legend.title=element_text(size=25))+theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.title.y=element_text(margin=margin(0,34,0,0)))+  theme(axis.title.x=element_text(margin=margin(34,0,0)))+theme(axis.ticks.length = unit(.3, "cm"))+
    theme(axis.line=element_blank(),text = element_text(size=20))+
   labs(x = "Set size", y = "Ignore vs Update \n Indifference point") +
  geom_text(label = 'Ignore preference', x = 1.5, y = 2.8, size = 5, colour = '#7F7377' )+
  geom_text(label = 'Update preference', x = 1.5, y = 1.1, size = 5, colour = '#7F7377' )

print(graph3)
```

Discounting parameters figures
```{r discounting params}
data_pb = read.csv(file=file.path(pool_dir, 'discParamsN.csv'),header=T,sep=',')
##parameters

disc_long <- data_pb %>% dplyr::rename(bias_I = biasI, bias_U = biasU) %>%
    dplyr::select(c("sub", "kappa_I", "kappa_U", "beta_I", "beta_U", "bias_I", "bias_U")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -sub,
                 names_to = c(".value", "condition"),
                 names_sep = "_")

##make summary statistics
kappaS = summarySEwithin(disc_long, measurevar=c("kappa"), withinvar='condition',idvar="sub")
betaS = summarySEwithin(disc_long, measurevar=c("beta"), withinvar='condition',idvar="sub")
biasS = summarySEwithin(disc_long, measurevar=c("bias"), withinvar='condition',idvar="sub")

##colors
#purple, grey: "#999999"(grey), '#80002a (red dark),"#c2d6d6" (veraman), '#ffccdd, 9f8fcf (lilac),5552c2 (blue) "#1f676d", '#80002a'
#"#E69F00"(orange), "#56B4E9"(light blue), "#009E73"(bright green), "#F0E442" (yellow), "#0072B2" (blue), "#D55E00" (red), 0b086a (dark blue)

######discounting parameters####
#kappa
pd=position_dodge(w=0.15)
p3=ggplot(kappaS, aes(y = kappa ,x = condition,group=1)) + #geom_point(size=3)+
  geom_line(size=0.95)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=kappa-se, ymax=kappa+se), width = 0.05,position = position_dodge( w =0.15),size=1)+
theme_classic()+#ylim(c(0,0.75))+
 labs(y = "Discounting parameter (k)",x='Condition')+
  geom_jitter(data=disc_long,aes(condition,kappa,group=1),width = 0.05, alpha=0.2)+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=18))+
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', size = 1.5),axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = 1.8),
        text = element_text(size=18),axis.text =element_text(colour='#4D4E4F',size=18,face='bold'))

#beta
p4=ggplot(betaS, aes(y = beta ,x = condition,group=1)) + #geom_point(size=3)+
  geom_line(size=0.95)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=beta-se, ymax=beta+se), width = 0.05,position = position_dodge( w =0.15),size=1)+
  theme_classic()+#ylim(c(0,8))+
  labs(y = "Decision noise (inverse beta)",x='Condition')+
  geom_jitter(data=disc_long,aes(condition,beta,group=1),width = 0.05, alpha=0.2)+
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold",size=18))+
  theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', size = 1.5),axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = 1.8),
        text = element_text(size=18),axis.text =element_text(colour='#4D4E4F',size=18,face='bold'))
ggarrange(p3, p4,labels = c("A", "B") ,ncol = 2, nrow = 1)
```

```{r raw/sim data}
#read data
raw_data <- read.csv(file.path(pool_dir,'dataPooled.csv')) 
fit_exp <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'exponential', 'IPmatrixOut.csv'),header = T)
fit_lin <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'linear', 'IPmatrixOut.csv'),header = T)
fit_par <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'parabolic', 'IPmatrixOut.csv'),header = T)
fit_hyp <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'hyperbolic', 'IPmatrixOut.csv'),header = T)
fit_exp_bias <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'exponential_bias', 'IPmatrixOut.csv'),header = T)
fit_lin_bias <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'linear_bias', 'IPmatrixOut.csv'),header = T)
fit_par_bias <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'parabolic_bias', 'IPmatrixOut.csv'),header = T)
fit_hyp_bias <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'hyperbolic_bias', 'IPmatrixOut.csv'),header = T)

if (mod_type == 'fmin'){
fit_name <- 'discParamsN.csv'
#simulated evidence
ignore_of <- read.csv(file.path(pool_dir,'ignore_of_fmin.csv'))
update_of <- read.csv(file.path(pool_dir,'update_of_fmin.csv'))

}else {
fit_name <- 'vbaParamsN.csv'
#simulated evidence
ignore_of <- read.csv(file.path(pool_dir,'ignore_of.csv'))
update_of <- read.csv(file.path(pool_dir,'update_of.csv'))}



#make naming consistent
IP_raw <- raw_data[ ,c(1:3,9:16)]
names(IP_raw) <- c('subNo','I','U', "I1","I2","I3","I4","U1","U2","U3","U4") 

#model that generated data
fit_par$genMod <- 'parabolic'
fit_lin$genMod <- 'linear'
fit_hyp$genMod <- 'hyperbolic'
fit_exp$genMod <- 'exponential'
fit_par_bias$genMod <- 'parabolic_bias'
fit_lin_bias$genMod <- 'linear_bias'
fit_hyp_bias$genMod <- 'hyperbolic_bias'
fit_exp_bias$genMod <- 'exponential_bias'
IP_raw$genMod <- 'data'


#join all simulated data
all_fits <- rbind(fit_lin, fit_par, fit_hyp, fit_exp,fit_lin_bias, fit_par_bias, fit_hyp_bias, fit_exp_bias)
# raw data or sims
all_fits$type <- 'model'
IP_raw$type <- 'data'


#bind raw and simulated 
IP_all <- rbind(all_fits, IP_raw)
# unique subject number for every row (simulated and real participants)
IP_all$subNo <- 1:nrow(IP_all)


fitsLong=reshape(IP_all,varying =c( "I1","I2","I3","I4","U1","U2","U3","U4"),direction = "long",idvar = "subNo",timevar="setSize",sep="")
fits_data=reshape2:::melt.data.frame(fitsLong,id.vars=c('subNo','setSize','genMod','type'),value.name="IP",variable.name="condition",measure.vars=c("I","U"))

IP_raw_sum <- summarySEwithin(fits_data[fits_data$type=='data', ], measurevar = "IP", withinvars = c("setSize","condition"),idvar="subNo")

IP_fit_sum <- summarySEwithin(fits_data, measurevar = "IP", withinvars = c("setSize","condition"), betweenvars = c('genMod','type'),idvar="subNo")
```

correlation by set size
```{r correlations by set size}

ip_long <-  raw_data %>% dplyr::select(subNo,matches("^IP_[IU][1-4]$") ) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -subNo, names_to = c('condition', 'setSize'),  names_pattern ="IP_([IU])(\\d+)", values_to = "IP") 

dev_long <- raw_data %>% dplyr::select(subNo, matches("^dev[IU][1-4]$")) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -subNo, names_to = c('condition', 'setSize'),  names_pattern ="dev([IU])(\\d+)", values_to = "dev") 

raw_long <- inner_join(ip_long, dev_long, by = c('subNo', 'setSize', 'condition'))

raw_data_m <- raw_data %>% dplyr::mutate (devI1_U1 = devI1 - devU1, devI2_U2 = devI2 - devU2,devI3_U3 = devI3 - devU3,devI4_U4 = devI4 - devU4) 

cor_iu_1 <- cor.test(raw_data_m$IPtask, raw_data_m$devI1_U1, method="kendall")


iu_long <- raw_data_m %>% dplyr::select(subNo,IPtask, matches("^devI[1-4]_U[1-4]")) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(subNo, IPtask), names_to = 'setSize',  names_pattern = 'devI[1-4]_U(.*)$' , values_to = 'cond_diff')

iu_long_high <- iu_long %>% filter(setSize >=3)

iu_long_high$setSize <- factor(iu_long_high$setSize, levels = c(3:4),labels = c('Set size 3', 'Set size 4'))

dev_ip_long <- left_join(ip_long, dev_long, by= c('subNo', 'condition', 'setSize'))
dev_ip_wide <- dev_ip_long %>% pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = c(IP, dev))

dev_ip_diff <- dev_ip_wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    IP_diff = IP_I - IP_U,
    dev_diff = dev_I - dev_U
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(subNo, setSize, IP_diff, dev_diff)


BFs <- c(0.154, 0.160, 0.175, 0.296)

dev_ip_diff <- dev_ip_diff %>% dplyr::mutate(bf = dplyr::case_when(setSize == 1 ~ BFs[1], setSize == 2 ~ BFs[2], setSize == 3 ~ BFs[3],  TRUE ~ BFs[4]))

dev_ip_diff$setSize <- factor(dev_ip_diff$setSize, levels = c(1:4),labels = c('Set size 1', 'Set size 2', 'Set size 3', 'Set size 4'))

cor_results <- dev_ip_diff %>%
         dplyr::group_by(setSize) %>% dplyr::summarize(
                 r = cor(IP_diff, dev_diff, method = 'kendall'),
                 p = cor.test(IP_diff, dev_diff, method = 'kendall')$p.value
             )
 cor_results$BF <- BFs

#choice deviance relationship
ggplot(dev_ip_diff, aes(y = IP_diff,x = dev_diff)) + 
    geom_point(size=2)+
    geom_smooth(method=lm,size=2)+theme_classic()+
    labs( y = expression(paste(Delta, "Motivation (Ignore -  Update)")), x = expression(paste(Delta, "Deviance (Ignore -  Update)")))+
    theme(axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', size = 1.5),axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = 1.8),
          text = element_text(size=20),axis.text =element_text(colour='#4D4E4F',size=20,face='bold'))+
    facet_wrap(~setSize, nrow = 1, scales = 'free')+
    geom_text(data = cor_results, aes(fontface = 3,label = sprintf('R = %.3f, p = %.3f, BF = %.3f', r, p, BF)), 
             y = c(0.2, -1, 0.5,  -1.1), x = c(1, 2, 25, 7), size = 4, inherit.aes = FALSE)


#explorative correlation
ggplot(iu_long_high, aes(y = cond_diff,x = IPtask)) + 
  geom_point(size=2)+

          text = element_text(size=20),axis.text =element_text(colour='#4D4E4F',size=20,face='bold'))+
    annotate("segment", x = 0.3,xend=0.3, y = 25, yend = 50, colour = "black", size=1, alpha=0.6, arrow=arrow())+
    annotate(geom = "text", x = 0.48, y = 50, label = "Higher distractibility vs flexibility", hjust = "left")+ facet_wrap(~setSize, nrow = 1)+
```

```{r parameter recovery}
#Prepare data
params_par <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'parabolic', fit_name),header = T)
params_lin <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'linear', fit_name),header = T)
params_hyp <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'hyperbolic', fit_name),header = T)
params_exp <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'exponential', fit_name),header = T)
params_par_bias <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'parabolic_bias', fit_name),header = T)
params_lin_bias <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'linear_bias', fit_name),header = T)
params_hyp_bias <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'hyperbolic_bias', fit_name),header = T)
params_exp_bias <- read.csv(file.path(sim_dir, 'exponential_bias', fit_name),header = T)
if (mod_type == 'fmin'){
fit_params <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, 'Pooled','fitted_params.csv'))
} else {
fit_params <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, 'Pooled','fit_params_vba.csv'))}


#model that generated data
params_par$genMod <- 'par'
params_lin$genMod <- 'lin'
params_hyp$genMod <- 'hyp'
params_exp$genMod <- 'exp'
params_par_bias$genMod <- 'par_bias'
params_lin_bias$genMod <- 'lin_bias'
params_hyp_bias$genMod <- 'hyp_bias'
params_exp_bias$genMod <- 'exp_bias'

num_sims <- 100 #number of simulations
rep_fit <- do.call("rbind", replicate(num_sims, fit_params, simplify = FALSE)) #replicate by number of simulations

sim_params <- dplyr::bind_rows(params_exp,params_hyp,params_lin,params_par,params_exp_bias,params_hyp_bias,params_lin_bias,params_par_bias)

sim_params_bias <-  sim_params %>% dplyr::filter(grepl('bias',genMod))
```

```{r parameter recovery bU}

### BETA UPDATE ####
bU_all <- rep_fit  %>%  dplyr::select(starts_with('bU'))
bU_long <- bU_all %>% pivot_longer( cols = starts_with("bU_"), names_to = "genMod", names_prefix = "bU_", values_to = "fit_beta") 
bU_long <- bU_long %>% arrange(genMod)
bU_long$sim_beta <- sim_params$beta_U

range <- c(0,20)

pbU <- ggscatter(bU_long, y = 'sim_beta',x = 'fit_beta', color = "grey",alpha = 0.5, fill = "light grey",
               shape = 19, size = 2,
               add = "reg.line", conf.int = TRUE,  add.params = list(color = "black",
                                                                     fill = "grey",alpha = 0.4),
               cor.coef = TRUE, cor.method = "pearson",# label.x = 0.2, label.y = 0.8,
               ylab = "Simulated", xlab = "Fitted") + facet_wrap(~genMod, ncol = 4, scales = 'free')+
  font("xlab", size = 16) + font("ylab", size = 16)
pbU
```

```{r parameter recovery bI}

### BETA IGNORE ####
bI_all <- rep_fit  %>% dplyr:: select(starts_with('bI_'))
bI_long <- bI_all %>% pivot_longer( cols = starts_with("bI_"), names_to = "genMod", names_prefix = "bI_", values_to = "fit_beta") 
bI_long <- bI_long %>% arrange(genMod)
bI_long$sim_beta <- sim_params$beta_I

range <- c(0,10)

pbI <- ggscatter(bI_long, y = 'sim_beta',x = 'fit_beta', color = "grey",alpha = 0.3, fill = "light grey",
               shape = 19, size = 2,
               add = "reg.line", conf.int = TRUE,  add.params = list(color = "blue",
                                                                     fill = "grey",alpha = 0.4),
               cor.coef = TRUE, cor.method = "kendall", col= 'red',# label.x = 0.2, label.y = 0.8,
               ylab = "Simulated", xlab = "Fitted") + facet_wrap(~genMod, ncol = 4, scales = 'free')+
  font("xlab", size = 16) + font("ylab", size = 16)
pbI
## density plot
ggplot(data=bI_long, aes(x=sim_beta, group=genMod, color= genMod, fill=genMod)) +
    geom_density(adjust=1.5, alpha=.2)+ theme_classic2()
  pbI


```
all correlations
